scope: Independent design review of simulator ad-hoc signing and guarded Q13 v2 regeneration proposal; no implementation or runtime acceptance.

findings.priorFailure: The observed Release startup stopped at the first local logout-control read before profile storage preparation or Q13 resume. The source-supported categories are corrupt and unavailable; neither category was established by the UI receipt.
findings.signingDecision: Correcting CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO to normal simulator ad-hoc Xcode signing is justified by the reported signature Identifier mismatch and linker-signed flags as an artifact-fidelity correction. This does not prove signing caused the logout-control failure.
findings.artifactGate: Before install require CFBundleIdentifier and signature Identifier equal the configured bundle ID, ad-hoc Xcode signing without linker-signed flags, and codesign --verify --deep --strict success.
findings.regeneration: A separate v2-to-v2 recovery must bind the prior exact five-path patch/build, reject changed or extra paths before mutation, preserve the prior binding, and issue a distinct fresh nonce/new private binding.
findings.statePreservation: Same simulator/app identity and ordinary install without app-data clearing preserve the intended same-app test condition. No product configuration, entitlement, Keychain, storage, or learning-state mutation is justified.
findings.repeatFailure: If the local logout gate fails again, stop without retry, clearing, removal, or bypass. A separately reviewed one-read probe may distinguish corrupt from unavailable without profile bootstrap if further diagnosis is needed.
findings.releaseGap: The plan does not yet establish corrected artifact validity or any downstream Q13 behavior. Acceptance still needs real old-success/new-mismatch receipts, preservation comparison, and ordinary UI evidence.

notClaimed: Signing was the cause of the prior SecureStore/Keychain read failure
Corrected signing will make local logout control available
Q13 resume reached in the prior Release run
